responsibility: This implementation module realizes the String-oriented convenience layer over the core FIO file subsystem. It converts DynamicStrings.String filenames into raw string/length pairs for exists and file opening, provides WriteS as a String-to-file wrapper around FIO.WriteNBytes, and implements ReadS by accumulating characters from FIO until end-of-line or end-of-file while consuming the trailing newline. Its role is narrower than FIO itself: it does not manage buffering or descriptors, but adapts those services to DynamicStrings-based callers.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation half of the SFIO pair: unlike SFIO.def, it converts DynamicStrings filenames to raw string/length arguments for FIO, wraps WriteNBytes for WriteS, and builds ReadS results by reading characters until end-of-line or end-of-file.
